scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E1-NO-IMPORT: The 31 previously closed historical selections have 100 verified runtime source nodes. Neither of the two proposed owner-change paths is in those closures; the graph is retained by hash.
scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E2-LAZY-DOSSIER: The minimal business-services patch adds one type-only import and one pure async function definition, then replaces only the prepareProcurement and revalidateProcurement callbacks inside business.procurementDossier.prepare. Factory construction does not execute those bodies. Existing descriptors and C12 preparation are unchanged. No selection in the 81-file corpus invokes business.procurementDossier; the direct consumer proof is WP04 host-integration outside that corpus.
scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E3-UI-NOT-EMITTED: Only the decisionApplyScript string changes; decisionApplyForms and module prefix are byte-identical. Generic workbench GET emits this script, so that route is material. The corpus does not render or execute that route: personal-views uses workbench-views POST and the ordinary Planner decorator (which has no decisionApplyScript); workbench-analysis returns at the analysis branch before HTML construction. WP06 import/document renderers and native contribution components use separate scripts.
scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E4-CLI-DOSSIER-DISTINCT: createSfDossierServices consumes business.procurement, sourcingEvidence, resolveProcurement, procurementSelections and registry directly. It does not call business.procurementDossier. The five dossier-runtime cases exercise the CLI consumer, so their W4 outcomes are preserved by this minimal wrapper-only change, but cannot qualify OPS-HOST-01B.
scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E5-CAS-BODY: The restored hunk is inside createPreparedExecution after receipt/classification; it changes no import, API or module initialization. The 81-file corpus does not reach that body. The three C12 direct-port selections call createSfPreparedApply from prepared-apply.ts, whose runtime imports exclude apply.ts.
scopeExceptionDefinitions.W5-E6-EXPLICIT-FIXTURES: Four owner fixtures are consumed only by the new explicit startup/host-integration/lifecycle Bun selection. Startup/finalizer .test.ts files are not implicitly included in historical exact-file requests. No shared preload/discovery/config is changed.
